name: Tor Project #tor (OFTC IRC)
discord_description: OFTC IRC channel for Tor user support and community discussion, bridged with the Matrix room.
candidate_notes: Network irc.oftc.net, channel #tor; webchat available via OFTC's site.

name: Qubes OS Forum
discord_description: Discourse-based forum for Qubes OS discussion, support, and localized communities; the project's primary user support venue.
candidate_notes: No signup gating beyond normal Discourse account creation.

name: Qubes OS Matrix
discord_description: Official Matrix room for real-time Qubes OS community chat, intended to bridge with the Libera IRC channel.
candidate_notes: Companion IRC channel is #qubes on irc.libera.chat.

name: Qubes OS #qubes (Libera IRC)
discord_description: Libera.Chat IRC channel for real-time Qubes OS discussion, meant to bridge with the project's Matrix room.
candidate_notes: Bridging between IRC and Matrix has had technical limitations per the docs.

name: Whonix Forum
discord_description: Official Discourse forum for the Whonix anonymity/privacy OS, covering support for Qubes-Whonix, KVM, and VirtualBox builds plus development discussion.
candidate_notes: No separate Matrix/IRC found; the forum is the primary community venue.

name: KeePassXC (Matrix, user support)
discord_description: Official Matrix room for KeePassXC password manager user questions and support.
candidate_notes: Bridged to IRC #keepassxc on irc.libera.chat. A separate dev room exists (#keepassxc-dev:mozilla.org).
